in_sanskrit.name: अदित्य
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Lord of the Sun, the god of light, energy, and time. He is also identified as Agni and Indra.

in_hindi.name: अदित्यान
in_hindi.long_meaning: Adityan means 'son of the Sun God'. In Hindu mythology, Aditya is the name of the Sun God, and is also known as Surya or Ravi.

in_tamil.name: அடித்யான
in_tamil.long_meaning: Adityan is derived from the Tamil word 'ஆஜ்டி' (Aadi), meaning 'beginning', and the suffix '-yan', meaning 'son'. Thus, Adityan can be interpreted as 'son of the beginning' or 'son of the primordial god'.

in_telugu.name: అదిత్యాన్
in_telugu.long_meaning: Adityan is a Telugu name for the Sun God, who is also known as Surya or Aditya. The name can be broken down into 'అదియ్' (Aditya) and '-యాన్' (yan), which together mean 'son of Aditya'. The long form of the name reflects the Sun God's various roles as a deity, including the provider of light, energy, and time.

in_marathi.name: Adityan
in_marathi.long_meaning: Adityan हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Adityan is the name of the Sun God in Hindu mythology. He is also known as Surya and is considered the god of energy, life, and strength. The name Adityan is derived from Aditya, which means 'sun' in Sanskrit.
